text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan and I are having a meeting
when...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yikes... My nails have gotten way too
long.
There's so much natural nail
showing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
In what free time? All I do is race, race,
race.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to switch to a ne...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I keep on top of my toenails, but... my

fingernails? Well, I guess like this is
better than
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For someone who's always so particular
about her nails, this is a rare sight. She
must really be fatigued. It might be a
good idea to take another look at her
race schedule.
